edges: B of the Bang was designed by Thomas Heatherwick.
B of the Bang was commissioned to mark the 2002 Commonwealth Games.
B of the Bang was located in Manchester.
B of the Bang was taller than the Angel of the North.
Legal action resulted in an out-of-court settlement for B of the Bang.
Manchester City Council announced the dismantling of B of the Bang.
A time capsule was placed in one of the spikes of B of the Bang.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Both Manchester and Liverpool had significantly higher overall death-rates than the national average.

edges: Connell Brothers Limited began removing B of the Bang.
